description: This file declares functions for building various DCI (Downlink Control Information) messages used in 5G NR scheduling, specifically for different RNTI types and message types within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_si_rnti
methods.description: Builds DCI f1_0 for SI-RNTI used in SIBs.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_p_rnti
methods.description: Builds DCI f1_0 for P-RNTI used in PCCHs.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_p_rnti (short messages)
methods.description: Builds DCI f1_0 with only short messages for P-RNTI used in PCCHs.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_ra_rnti
methods.description: Builds DCI f1_0 for RA-RNTI used in RAR.

methods.name: build_dci_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Builds DCI f1_0 for TC-RNTI, used in Msg4.

methods.name: build_dci_f0_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Builds DCI f0_0 for TC-RNTI, used in Msg3 retransmissions.
